title: Elderflower infusion for hay fever
subtitle: A hot infusion of dried Sambucus nigra flowers for seasonal allergic rhinitis
excerpt: Elderflower infusion is a hot tea of dried Sambucus nigra flowers steeped for 10 minutes, taken for the sneezing, watery eyes, and nasal congestion of hay fever and seasonal allergic rhinitis. Long used in European herbal tradition as a diaphoretic and anticatarrhal herb for the upper respiratory mucosa. One to three cups daily through the pollen season. Sweet-scented, mildly muscat-flavoured, delicate in colour.

glossaryTerms.definition: A herb that reduces excess mucus production and clears catarrh from the upper respiratory tract, nose, sinuses, and throat. Elderflower is one of the most widely used anticatarrhal herbs in European practice.

content.text: Elderflower infusion is a hot tea of dried elderflower, steeped for 10 minutes and drunk warm through the pollen season. A traditional

herb for hay fever. Used for sneezing, watery eyes, and a streaming nose during the pollen season. The sweat-inducing and membrane-toning actions work best when the tea is drunk hot rather than cold. Delicate in colour, sweet-scented, with the familiar muscat flavour.

attrs.title: Precautions
attrs.body: Not medical advice. Consult a qualified herbalist or doctor before use. Full precautions are in the 'When not to use' section.

content.text: Place 2 teaspoons of dried elderflower in a teapot or heatproof cup. Pour 200 ml of just-boiled water over the flowers. Cover and steep for 10 minutes.
Strain through a fine strainer into a mug. Drink hot. Honey may be added. For hay fever, drink before going outside during high pollen periods.
One to three cups daily during the pollen season. Elderflower is best used consistently throughout the hay fever season rather than on-and-off.
Dried elderflower stores 12 months in a sealed tin away from light and heat. Prepare each cup fresh.
When not to use this remedy

See a doctor if hay fever symptoms disrupt sleep, work, or daily life. Also see a doctor if they come with asthma or chest tightness. Elderflower is a gentle herb. It is not a replacement for antihistamines when allergy is severe.
